summary: Restored the jinja2 package under src/jinja2 by fixing Python 3.10 syntax errors, rewriting the stubbed or removed parser, idtracking and compiler, and filling the stubbed environment, runtime, filters, tests, loaders, sandbox, extensions (including i18n), bytecode cache, meta and native types modules. The last full-suite run I saw was 850 passed and 1 failed; the failure is tests/test_loader.py::TestFileSystemLoader::test_caches_template_based_on_mtime, which cannot set the mtime of a root-owned fixture file in this jail (PermissionError from os.utime), and the mtime reload logic was verified separately on a self-owned file.
